name: – After § 6 – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued crackdown on civic space and fundamental freedoms in Burkina Faso
part_text: 6e. Supports the diplomatic initiatives undertaken by Benin and Senegal to engage with Burkina Faso, with a view to de-escalating tensions between the Economic Community of West African States and the Alliance of Sahel States and to fostering joint action on the common problems faced by the countries of the region;
